prompt:

The ONLY changes are the subtitle and author grouping. Preserve the entire upper courgette illustration, the full main title 'The Vegetable Guru', and the entire lower tomato illustration and angled foreground YouTube sticker in their existing sizes and positions, with identical drawing style, typography, colour and wording. Do not add a decorative sprout to the title. Do not change or rearrange the existing main title or its relationship to the courgettes.

Precisely requested supporting-text changes, using the input 1101x1429 pixel coordinate system as guidance:
1. Move the existing two-line subtitle up and left. KEEP its existing rounded chunky typeface, approximate type size, dark green colour, exact words and line break: line 1 'Your at-a-glance'; line 2 'growing companion'. Set BOTH lines flush LEFT, not centred. Their visible left edges should be about x=90, aligned optically with the left edge of the G in 'Guru'. Place top of subtitle lettering at about y=665, bringing it noticeably closer below Guru (which ends around y=600). Subtitle block should end roughly y=775. Keep generous legibility and natural line spacing.
2. Move 'John Lennon' left onto that SAME optical left edge x=90 and slightly up to about y=840. Reduce author lettering size by about 15% from the input. Keep same typeface and dark green. Author block around 45px high, ending around y=885. It must read as secondary to the subtitle, with a distinct but modest gap under it.
3. Restore matching uninterrupted cream texture where the old centred subtitle and author were. Preserve intentional open cream space on the right of the newly left-aligned supporting text. Avoid any boxes, rules, panels, extra leaves or new decoration.
The result should feel like one coherent left-anchored title/subtitle/author hierarchy. This is a typography placement edit, not an artwork redraw or a different cover design. Exact visible wording: The / Vegetable / Guru; Your at-a-glance / growing companion; John Lennon; As seen on / YouTube / @hackriculture.
purpose: Unify left-aligned title, subtitle and smaller author name; retain the offset courgettes, lower tomatoes and sticker.
